# Retail CoD 1.5b dedicated server, mp_carentan tdm, client-probes/probe_skyshot spot part with the shooter's eye inside the 0x2080 caulk brush (1164..1220, -544..-528, 366..430) over a window, looking flat along +y, panzerfaust_mp, captured 2026-10-20:
#   COD_VERSION=1.5 COD_DIR=<stock 1.5 main/> PORT=33875 PROBE_SECS=45 tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_skyshot mp_carentan +set probe_part spot +set probe_weapon panzerfaust_mp +set probe_x 1192 +set probe_y -536 +set probe_z 340 +set probe_yaw 90 +set probe_pitch 0
#   vcod --game-dir <stock 1.5 install> --net-probe 127.0.0.1:33875 --probe-team allies --probe-uo-weapon aim --probe-secs 28
# The rocket's first move starts inside the brush, which fire_rocket's clipmask 0x2802091 meets: a start-solid contact, so it goes off at the end of that move (combat doc 11.1, 12.3). 1.5b's G_MissileTrace (0x54a5e) stores fraction 0 and normalize(start - end), so the explode packs the byte of the reversed flight.
